commands.name: run
commands.description: Runs Unity BuildPipeline from a build profile and emits final JSON with build artifacts: build.json, build-report.json, build.log, output-manifest.json, output/. --profilePath is required.

options.name: --profile-path
options.description: path to the build profile JSON that defines build inputs, runner, and policy. [Default: null]

options.name: --project-path
options.description: optional target Unity project path. [Default: null]

options.name: --format
options.description: Progress entry format (text|json) for entries written to standard error. [Default: null]
